plan.title: session:start leaves tracked .eval/README.md and a current AGENTS.md managed section unchanged

narratives.Description: On a clean checkout, `deft session:start` must leave tracked files unchanged when they are current. Today the legacy triage-cache migration deletes a tracked `xbrief/.eval/README.md` on every run. This story stops that deletion and adds a regression test: two `session:start` runs on a committed install leave `git status --porcelain` empty and AGENTS.md byte-identical. The managed-body template choice (`.deft/core` vs project-dependency) is out of scope (#6687).
narratives.Overview:
Narrow part of #7021. The managed-body template choice (`.deft/core` vs project-dependency) stays with #6687.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `deft session:start` does not delete a tracked `xbrief/.eval/README.md` (or legacy `vbrief/.eval/README.md`) and does not create `.triage-cache/README.md` in its place.
- [ ] When the AGENTS.md managed-section body is current, `deft session:start` leaves AGENTS.md byte-identical: no new `refreshed=` timestamp or `session=` id.
- [ ] A regression test runs `session:start` twice on a clean committed install that tracks `xbrief/.eval/README.md`, and `git status --porcelain` is empty after each run.

Refs #7021, #6687
narratives.UserStory: As an agent starting work in a fresh worktree, I want `deft session:start` to leave tracked files alone when they are current, so that the worktree is clean before I write a line and I never commit Directive's own churn.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/triage/cache-path.ts: the legacy triage-cache migration (`migrateLegacyTriageCacheFromEval`) no longer handles README.md. It leaves `.eval/README.md` in place and does not create `.triage-cache/README.md`; `triage:bootstrap` still creates the canonical README on request (clause 1).
2. packages/core/src/triage/cache-path.test.ts: the two README tests change to pin that the legacy README stays and no canonical README is created by the migration (clause 1).
3. packages/runtime/src/session-start-clean-7057.test.ts (new): a committed fresh install that also tracks `xbrief/.eval/README.md`; run the built runtime `session:start` twice; after each run `git status --porcelain -uall` is empty and AGENTS.md is byte-identical to the committed copy (clauses 2, 3).
4. changelog.d/7057-session-start-clean-worktree.md.
narratives.Traces: #7057 is the narrow part of #7021 (Expected: no writes to tracked files; no deleting tracked docs). The template part of #7021 stays with #6687.
